name.ja: HGUC 1/144 ドラッツェ(ユニコーンVer.)

description.ja: “袖付き”の特徴を、新規パーツと成形色で忠実に再現！！
description.en: The features of “sleeves” are faithfully reproduced with new parts and molding colors! !

description.ja: 機動戦士ガンダム UCの設定を完全再現した‘episode3’に登場のドラッツェがいよいよリリース！
description.en: The Doraze that appeared in 'episode 3', which completely reproduced the setting of Mobile Suit Gundam UC, is finally released!

description.ja: 劇中に登場のＭ.Ｓ.を揃えて、ユニコーンの世界観を堪能しよう！
description.en: Get the MS that appears in the movie and enjoy the world of unicorns!

description.ja: ●特徴的な右手のガトリングと腕の一体化装着部の他、マークが刻まれた胸部と袖部に新規パーツを採用
description.en: - In addition to the characteristic right hand Gatling and integrated arm attachment, new parts are used on the chest and sleeve parts with marks engraved on them.

description.ja: ●本体のパープルの塗り分けは成形色により再現
description.en: -The purple coloring of the main body is reproduced by molding color.

description.ja: ●胸と手首部分のエングレーピングは専用ホイルシールが付属。
description.en: -Special foil seals are included for the engraving on the chest and wrists.
